main_text.p: quem, nisi me fallit memoria, D. Scrimgerus beatæ memoriæ, sibi cognatum hic olim appellabat: quibuscum, adiunctla meo nomine officiosissima salutatione, peto ut has tibi communes esse literas velis: Deum precatus, mi suavissime frater, ut vos ipsi hic omnes quam potentissime & felicissime adversus omnia pericula domi & foris tueatur. Bene vale. Genevæ, Calendis Novembris, veteri nostro calculo.

page.notes: The first line is an uncertain transcription of the italic opening; "adiunctla" and "ipsi" read as printed/likely; the date "cIc Ic xcvi" is in the old reversed-C form, rendered as MDXCVI in Roman capitals per convention. Scattered specks and show-through on the page are not transcribed.
